verdicts.summary: [L] proves less than [M] prints. [M] prints `For every $d\ge4$, finitely many sums`.
evidence: `Org.erases` (Org/Input.lean:149-152) says only that there is some n such that, for every d ≥ n, a `Winds` family (Input.lean:141-146, matching B_d) with all Ward sums zero is zero. `Maxwell.Free.erasing` (Next/MAXWELL/AwayTeam.lean:48) concludes `erases`, and 4 appears only inside its proof (`refine ⟨4,?_⟩`, :49). Finite selection is the generic `Work.A07.finite_rows` (Work/A07.lean:27), used only inside `transfer` (:258), so 'for every d ≥ 4, finitely many sums separate B_d' is not stated.

`Org.erases` (Org/Input.lean:149-152) is ∃ n, ∀ d ≥ n, and the value 4 enters only in the proof of `Maxwell.Free.erasing` (`refine ⟨4,?_⟩`, Next/MAXWELL/AwayTeam.lean:48-49). The lemmas with explicit hd : 4 ≤ d (Born.lean:51, Racers.lean:32,57, Magnitude.lean:142) are ingredients and state no separation. No declaration picks finitely many separating sums for B_d.
